## Checklist
- [ ] New dependencies: an ADR-lite line each (why · licence · maintainer health · transitive count), or "none"
- [ ] [U] facts proven or disproven, and written back into ARCHITECTURE.md, or "none"
- [ ] CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, ADRs and runbooks updated where this PR changes them
- [ ] No F1 TV feed or archive data, no secret, no real recording in the diff (A§12.1)
